public_definitions: Routing criterion: 'Larger 2020 regional value shown in the dashboard'
Goal: compare the 2020 reported value for U.S. and Rest of the world, then open the regional statistics follow-up record for the region with the larger 2020 value.
uncertain: The chart uses two separate y-axes (left for Rest of the world, right for U.S.) but neither axis shows numeric tick values, so the absolute 2020 values cannot be read directly.
No numeric data labels are printed at the 2020.0 points for either series; the 2020 comparison must be inferred from marker vertical positions on their respective (unlabeled) axes.
Because the two series are plotted on independent scales, relative vertical position on the shared plot area does not by itself prove which 2020 value is numerically larger without the axis scales.
